title: Slack anomaly alerts
volume: A few a week in a large org: Slack flags travel and new networks too. Each anomaly is one detection, in the member's case.
mdr_note: These detections are yours to work. Sophos MDR doesn't work custom detections, and a case your own case rule opens from them is Managed By Self.
author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: One custom detection rule for Slack, on the third-party alert records the library's Slack parsers write from Slack's anomaly entries. It makes a detection when Slack flags a member's session as anomalous. It matches sensor type Slack Audit Logs only.
notes:
Setup:
- Add the library's Slack parsers and the example bridge in bridges/slack-audit-logs, and run the bridge, as the parser entry says. Then run the check-your-data search to see events arrive.

How it works:
- Slack writes an anomaly entry with reason codes, such as ip_address, asn or spoofed_user_agent. The parsers put the first three in the title and the member as the target user.
- Slack gives anomalies no severity, so the rule is Medium. Read the reasons in the title: unexpected_client and spoofed_user_agent matter more than ip_address alone.

Testing:
- In a lab tenant on 2026-11-23, each query returned exactly the sample lines tests.json lists in Data Lake Search, and the rules run offline on the same 2 records agreed. The samples went in with their dates moved to the day before the test, so they fell inside the search's time range.
- As live rules there, each one fired on exactly its sample lines within about a minute. The lines went in 21 minutes after the rules were made, and every rule fired on the first send.
- No Sophos detector made a detection on the lines these rules take. Sophos's sign-in analytics flagged only a sample sign-in on Auth, as an unseen user, address or application.
- The events went in through bridges/slack-audit-logs, run once on the lab machine against a local mock of the Slack Audit Logs API that served the sample events, and posted to HTTP Ingest as gzipped NDJSON, the way the bridge's README says.

Known gaps:
- The bridge polls, so detections arrive up to one poll interval after the event.
